limitations: Damage coefficients and anti-farming budget are local, user-authorized policy, NOT a recovered server formula. No bonus merely for entering/winning. Enemy damage only; each victim has one maximum-HP experience budget per battle. Premium subscription XP rules are in tio/premium.py. Stage4 applies the existing unordered account-pair six-hour factors to positive PvP XP and soldier rank: first three matches full, next three half, subsequent matches quarter. Progression uses the minimum opposing-pair factor for mixed teams; credits retain their average. Pair factors are frozen once per match and shared by both sides. This reduces repeated-player farming but does not prohibit collusion or account rotation. Existing higher base HP is retained; new levels add5 HP. Level gains do not heal or revive.
